title: Petrochemistry
description: Hydrocarbon chains, broken in a furnace into the short ones industry is built on. Unlocks Synthetic Crude and the Cracking Tower.

puzzle.goal: A straight chain of n carbons carries 2n + 2 hydrogens. With a carbon weighing c and a hydrogen h, write the molar mass M of the chain.
puzzle.name: Alkane mass
puzzle.ask: Find M in g/mol for n = @{n}, c = @{c} and h = 1.008.
puzzle.method: Each carbon in the middle holds two hydrogens; the two at the ends one more each.
